sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This policy explains what personal data NexaAI ("we", "us") processes when you visit NexaAI.ch or contact us through it, how we use it, and who we share it with. It covers this website and our communications with you only — separate agreements govern any client engagement or project work, and third-party sites we may link to are outside its scope.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.intro: We process a limited set of personal data:

bullets.label: Contact details.
bullets.body: The contact form opens an email in your own email app, addressed to us, with the name, business email, company, phone number, service of interest, and message you provide. Nothing is sent to our servers by the form itself.

bullets.label: Correspondence.
bullets.body: If you email us or we work together, we keep the messages and related business contact details needed to respond and follow up.

bullets.label: Basic hosting logs.
bullets.body: Our hosting provider (Vercel) automatically logs standard request data (such as IP address and browser type) for security and reliability. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers on this site.

sections.outro: All other content on this site (service descriptions, industry and use case pages, testimonials) is static and does not involve collecting any information from visitors.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use personal data only to run, secure, and support our website and services: to respond to your inquiry, to prepare and deliver agreed work, and to keep the site safe. We do not sell or rent your personal data, and we do not use it for marketing unless you separately opt in.

sections.heading: Legal bases
sections.intro: Where data protection law requires a legal basis, we rely on:

bullets.label: Contract.
bullets.body: processing needed to respond to your request and to enter into or perform an agreement with you.

bullets.label: Legal obligations.
bullets.body: processing needed to meet legal and regulatory requirements, such as accounting, tax, and security duties.

bullets.label: Legitimate interests.
bullets.body: keeping our site secure and providing support, balanced against your rights and interests.

bullets.label: Consent.
bullets.body: where required, and you may withdraw it at any time.

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent personal data. We share it only with service providers that help us operate the site (for example our hosting provider) under appropriate contractual protections, with professional advisors bound by confidentiality, or where disclosure is required by law.

sections.heading: International transfers
sections.body: We are based in Switzerland. Where our providers process data outside Switzerland or the EEA, we take steps to ensure an adequate level of protection, such as recognised contractual safeguards, as required by the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) and the GDPR.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We don't use tracking, advertising, or any other cookies on this site.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law. Contact form messages are sent from your own email app directly to our team's inbox and are not stored on our servers. When data is no longer needed, we delete it or securely erase it in line with applicable law.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures — such as access controls and encrypted connections — to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the nFADP and, where applicable, the GDPR, you may request access to, correction, erasure, or restriction of your personal data, and data portability. To exercise these rights, email {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children's data
sections.body: Our site and services are aimed at businesses and professionals. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the revised policy.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy? Email {email}.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By using NexaAI.ch (the "Site"), you agree to these terms. These terms govern use of the Site only — they don't govern any paid engagement with NexaAI, which is covered by a separate signed agreement or statement of work.

sections.heading: Use of the site
sections.body: The Site is provided for informational purposes — to describe our services, share industry solutions and use cases, and let you get in touch. You agree not to misuse the Site.

sections.heading: Engaging our services
sections.body: Descriptions of services on this Site are informational and do not constitute an offer or contract. Project scope, pricing, deliverables, and ownership of work product for any engagement are defined exclusively in a separate written agreement between NexaAI and the client.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Site's content, design, and the NexaAI name and logo are owned by NexaAI and may not be copied or reused without permission. This does not apply to deliverables produced under a separate client agreement, which is governed by that agreement's IP terms.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: The Site is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. We don't guarantee the Site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, NexaAI is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Site.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: The Site relies on third-party providers (Vercel) to operate. We aren't responsible for outages or issues originating from those providers.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Switzerland, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Email {email}.
